textual_basis.meaning: Every profile retains the engine/binary/configuration actually measured; old a23 raw never becomes new-main raw.
Performance is measured in release, all samples retained, profile-specific N/CI/coldness labels preserved. Debug/test results and incomparable profiles stay separately labelled.

textual_basis.text: latest 只是指针，不覆盖旧原始 run。
textual_basis.meaning: New studies append source-specific results; they do not overwrite the failed run.

textual_basis.text: L3 产品黑盒：当前精确构建的 MCP stdio 子进程
textual_basis.meaning: A black-box claim belongs to the exact binary used in its own execution; it is not automatically a claim about a later changed binary.

textual_basis.text: 同一 gate 的所有任务必须有当前 run-id 证据。
textual_basis.meaning: For a phase/release gate such as G8, the current declared gate scope needs its current evidence. The original selected subtask graph does not make P8-020/G8 a prerequisite of005..013/016.

The guard admits exact source and validation inputs. It explicitly neither relabels historical executions nor grants task/quality/release approval; runtime and quality claims require separate execution evidence.

conclusions: No original selected-task text requires every domain to share one Git SHA, or automatically rerunning all domains whenever main moves. Hard dependencies require completed predecessor tasks, not numerical equality of all evidence engine SHAs.

Conversely, a source approval, current-main merge or unchanged test harness cannot relabel an old binary's performance, resource, soak or recovery observations as measurements of the changed new binary.

Already qualified a23 component evidence remains valid historical, source-specific evidence. Main's change does not erase its original bytes or retroactively invalidate every completed milestone. Its use in a closure package must identify exact task/profile/source and preserve its original limitations.

Current-state claims require an explicit change-impact/related-regression review. If a changed implementation is material to the property being claimed, an older profile alone is insufficient for that new-source claim. The necessary additional evidence follows that concrete property; this is not blanket repetition of all domains.

Had a23 completed its original study, it could have supported005/006 and the other existing source-qualified domains within an explicitly a23-scoped milestone package, without falsely certifying changed main or G8. In reality it did not:146 original cells are missing, so this counterfactual cannot authorize any status change.

A future new complete study may be used as the scale evidence in a multi-source component package. The other accepted components may retain their original source identities. The final task-by-task review must distinguish those historical measurements from any unmeasured new-source performance/resource assertions and confirm related regressions as already required.

One complete replacement study can jointly satisfy005 and006; transitive dependencies do not require another duplicate150 study for each of007..013/016. No extraG2 auxiliary run, paid/live provider, P8-020 approval or invented tail/stability claim has been added.
